description: Get the coding conventions Moxie Docs inferred for the repository. Read-only; no side effects. Returns a Markdown list grouped by category (e.g. testing, structure, docs, review); each convention has a title, summary, confidence score, agent guidance, and the source file paths that evidence it. Use this for the general rules to follow; when you already know the files you're about to edit, prefer moxie.get_doc_impact for conventions scoped to those paths.

category.description: Optional category filter, such as testing, structure, docs, or review.

repository.description: The target repository as "owner/name" (e.g. "acme/app"). Always pass this unless your token is scoped to a single repository. Matching is case-insensitive. If omitted when the token serves multiple repos, the call returns the list of repositories to choose from instead of an answer.

name: moxie.get_conventions
